hypothesis: The positive intensity-centroid mechanism is sensitive to physical crop support, and a radius selected only on checkpoint-validation movies can transfer across embryos better than the single open-source radius.
parent: Frozen scratch detector coordinates with registered linking and direction-specific EXP190 short-track pruning.

selection.forward: Evaluate translation plus all six radii only on the two held-out 44b6 checkpoint-validation movies with min8; choose maximum pooled source score.
selection.reverse: Evaluate translation plus all six radii only on the two held-out 6bba checkpoint-validation movies with min3; choose maximum pooled source score.
selection.tie_break: translation first, then the listed radius order within absolute score tolerance 1e-12
selection.target_blinding: No target-family metric is computed until both source selections are written. Each target direction evaluates only translation and its single selected arm.

target_evaluation: Apply the frozen forward arm to all 12 6bba target movies and the frozen reverse arm to all 12 44b6 target movies; create both outputs before the pooled comparison and 20,000-draw stability analysis.
evidence_grade: Source-selected cross-embryo mechanism test, but the radius-family idea was motivated after seeing EXP205 on the same 24 target cohort. Treat as cohort-adaptive development evidence; the untouched 175-movie EXP192 cohort is the confirmation.
promotion_for_untouched_confirmation: Positive pooled 24-movie delta is primary. Directional deltas, paired bootstrap, leave-one-movie-out, edge/adjusted-edge, node recall/count and division counts are mandatory diagnostics but do not veto a positive pooled result under the corrected objective.
data_reuse: Uses existing EXP152 source/target detector caches and existing raw pilot images. No neural inference or new model weights.
resource_policy: CPU-only. Do not run until EXP192 archive transfer and exact staging audit finish; do not contend with extraction. No GPU lease.
verification_before_remote_integration: Ten focused evaluator, selector, runner and atomic CPU-launcher contract tests pass. The target control additionally requires exact per-movie predicted-node-count invariance.
